items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bc-fips 1.0.2.7 (1.0.X series), 2.0.2 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.3 (2.1.X series), sensitive key material held by the AES and DESede engines, the SP 800-90A DRBGs, SymmetricSecretKey and the PBKD and scrypt parameter classes was zeroised on garbage collection by overriding Object.finalize. Finalization runs at an unspecified time and in an unspecified order and is serviced by a single finalizer thread, so where objects carrying a finalizer are allocated faster than that thread retires them the pending-finalization queue grows without bound: disposal falls arbitrarily far behind, which can contribute to an OutOfMemoryError under load, and the key material those objects hold stays resident in the heap for as long as they are queued, defeating the purpose of the zeroisation. The behaviour was not a problem on Java 8 or Java 11; it is later JVMs, on which finalization has been deprecated and progressively de-emphasised, where it becomes one. Disposal of these classes now runs from a java.lang.ref.Cleaner registered in the multi-release jdk1.9 overlay, so on Java 9 and later it no longer depends on the finalizer being scheduled. Bouncy Castle for Java (bcprov) and Bouncy Castle for Java LTS are not affected, as neither implements the finalizer-based zeroisation scheme.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) 在 1.0.2.7、2.0.2 和 2.1.3 之前的版本中，其 AES 和 DESede 引擎、SP 800-90A DRBG、SymmetricSecretKey 以及 PBKD 和 scrypt 参数类持有敏感密钥材料，并通过重写 Object.finalize 方法在垃圾回收时进行零化（zeroise）。然而，finalize 机制在 Java 9+ 上已被弃用并逐渐弱化，且终结操作由单一 finalizer 线程按不确定的时间和顺序执行。当对象创建速度快于该线程处理速度时，待终结队列会无限增长，导致内存回收严重滞后，可能引发 OutOfMemoryError；同时，密钥材料在排队期间仍驻留堆内存，使零化机制失去意义。该问题在 Java 8 和 Java 11 上不明显，但在后续 JVM 上更严重。Bouncy Castle for Java (bcprov) 和 Bouncy Castle LTS 不受影响。修复版本改用 java.lang.ref.Cleaner（通过多版本 jar 的 jdk1.9 overlay 注册），在 Java 9 及以上不再依赖终结器调度。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞导致 FIPS 模式下的敏感密钥材料可能长时间残留在堆内存中，破坏零化保障，增加密钥泄露风险；同时高负载下可能引发内存溢出，影响服务可用性。使用 BC-FJA 的加密服务需及时升级。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者若能读取堆内存（如通过侧信道或内存转储），可能获取仍未清除的密钥；系统可能因内存耗尽拒绝服务。影响 AES/DESede/DRBG/密钥派生等核心加密功能。

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bc-fips 2.1.3, the native entropy source used on Intel platforms retried the CPU entropy instructions without any bound. RDSEED an...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bc-fips 2.1.3, the native entropy source used on Intel platforms retried the CPU entropy instructions without any bound. RDSEED and RDRAND report failure through their carry flag, and the JNI seeding routine spun re-issuing the instruction for as long as that flag stayed clear, so a persistent failure of the on-chip entropy source - whether from a hardware fault, from the underlying DRBG being exhausted by contention across many cores, or from a hypervisor that does not provide the instruction - left the calling thread looping indefinitely inside the JNI call, where it could be neither interrupted nor timed out. Any operation drawing from the native entropy source could therefore hang, denying service to the application. The retry loops are now bounded (200 attempts for RDSEED and 20 for RDRAND, twice the baselines given in Intel's Digital Random Number Generator software implementation guide), pausing between attempts and, on exhaustion, clearing any partially written buffer and throwing rather than continuing to spin. The clear is performed by an un-elidable memzero, which uses a volatile pointer and an assembly memory barrier so that a compiler cannot optimise the erase away as a dead store. Bouncy Castle for Java (bcprov) is not affected, as it has no native entropy source; the 1.0.X and 2.0.X FIPS series are not affected.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-8798 是 Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS（BC-FJA）在 bc-fips 2.1.3 之前版本中存在的一个拒绝服务（DoS）漏洞。该漏洞影响 Intel 平台上的原生熵源实现。具体而言，JNI 种子例程在调用 RDSEED 和 RDRAND 指令时，未对重试次数进行限制。这两条 CPU 指令通过进位标志（carry flag）报告失败，而漏洞中的循环在标志未清除的情况下会无限重发指令，导致调用线程在 JNI 调用中无限循环，且无法被中断或超时。造成这一持续失败的原因可能包括硬件故障、多核竞争导致底层 DRBG 耗尽，或者虚拟机管理程序不提供该指令。任何依赖该原生熵源的操作都可能因此挂起，从而使应用程序拒绝服务。修复版本 bc-fips 2.1.3 对重试循环进行了限制：RDSEED 最多 200 次，RDRAND 最多 20 次（为 Intel DRNG 软件实现指南中基线的两倍），并在尝试之间加入暂停；若尝试耗尽，则会清除部分写入的缓冲区并抛出异常，而不是继续空转。缓冲区清除使用不可消除的 memzero（通过 volatile 指针和汇编内存屏障防止编译器将擦除优化为死存储）。Bouncy Castle for Java (bcprov) 不受影响，因为它没有原生熵源；1.0.X 和 2.0.X FIPS 系列也不受影响。该漏洞需要攻击者能够触发影响原生熵源的条件（如控制硬件或虚拟化环境），但恶意代码本身并不需要特殊权限。此漏洞为拒绝服务性质，无 CVSS 评分，且未列入 KEV，无在野利用证据。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可导致使用 BC-FJA 的 Java 应用在生成随机数时无限挂起，造成拒绝服务。由于影响 FIPS 认证库，合规环境中的安全服务可能中断。修复简单（升级到 2.1.3），但若无法立即升级，需评估运行环境（如是否依赖硬件熵源）并考虑限制暴露。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可能通过导致 CPU 熵指令持续失败（例如利用虚拟机管理程序缺陷或硬件故障）使目标线程无限循环，从而中断依赖随机数的操作（如密钥生成、签名），最终造成应用不可用。

items.title: Klever-Go is the Go implementation of the Klever blockchain protocol. Versions from 1.7.14 through 1.7.17 are vulnerable to a remotely triggerable denial of service. Both REST A...
items.summary: Klever-Go is the Go implementation of the Klever blockchain protocol. Versions from 1.7.14 through 1.7.17 are vulnerable to a remotely triggerable denial of service. Both REST APIs are started with the Gin Engine.Run convenience method, which serves requests through Go's default HTTP server with no ReadHeaderTimeout, ReadTimeout, or MaxHeaderBytes configured. As a result, incoming connections that never complete their request headers are held open indefinitely. When a REST listener is reachable beyond localhost through the documented all-interface bind or a Docker port-publish deployment, a single unauthenticated client can open many slow-header connections and hold them open until server file descriptors are exhausted, preventing the API from accepting new connections. This renders the REST API unavailable to legitimate clients. This issue is fixed in version 1.7.18.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Klever-Go 是 Klever 区块链协议的 Go 实现，其 REST API 使用 Gin 框架的 `Engine.Run` 便捷方法启动。该方法依赖于 Go 标准库的 `http.Server`，但未设置 `ReadHeaderTimeout`、`ReadTimeout` 或 `MaxHeaderBytes`。此配置缺陷使得攻击者可以发送不完整的 HTTP 请求头，服务器将无限期等待这些连接，直至资源耗尽。在默认配置下，REST 服务可能仅绑定到 localhost，因此风险较低；但当用户通过 `0.0.0.0` 绑定所有接口或通过 Docker 端口映射暴露服务时，远程未认证攻击者即可利用此漏洞。攻击者可以建立大量慢速连接，耗尽服务器的文件描述符，导致 REST API 无法接受新请求，从而造成拒绝服务。该漏洞影响版本 1.7.14 至 1.7.17，已在 1.7.18 中修复。CVSS v3.1 评分为 7.5，攻击向量为网络，复杂度低，无需特权或用户交互，影响可用性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可被远程未认证攻击者利用，导致核心区块链 REST API 不可用，影响关键业务，需尽快修复。

items.title: Klever-Go is the Go implementation of the Klever blockchain protocol. In versions 1.7.14 through 1.7.17, the direct-message ingress handler spawns a new goroutine for every inco...
items.summary: Klever-Go is the Go implementation of the Klever blockchain protocol. In versions 1.7.14 through 1.7.17, the direct-message ingress handler spawns a new goroutine for every incoming direct message before the processor-level antiflood layer makes any admission decision, with no semaphore, throttler, or bound on the number of concurrent in-flight spawns. Because the antiflood check runs inside the spawned goroutine rather than before it, a single connected peer can open a direct-send stream and send a stream of well-formed messages to force unbounded goroutine creation, where each goroutine allocates its own stack and holds a message reference until processing completes, adding scheduler and garbage-collection pressure faster than the runtime can drain it. This lets one peer degrade the node's availability and its ability to process legitimate traffic, resulting in a remotely triggerable denial of service. The issue is fixed in 1.7.18.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Klever-Go是Klever区块链协议的Go实现。在版本1.7.14至1.7.17中，其直接消息入口处理器在处理每个传入的直接消息时，会在处理器层面的防洪水层做出接纳决定之前，就为每条消息新建一个goroutine，且没有信号量、节流器或对并发在途执行数量的任何限制。由于防洪水检查是在已启动的goroutine内部执行，而不是在启动之前执行，因此单个已连接的节点可以打开一条直接发送流，并连续发送一系列格式规范的合法消息，从而强制创建数量不受上限的goroutine。每个goroutine都会分配自己的栈空间，并持有一条消息引用直至处理完毕，导致调度器和垃圾回收器的压力增长速度快于运行时能够排空的速度。这样，单个节点就可以降低目标节点的可用性及其处理合法流量的能力，形成可远程触发的拒绝服务攻击。该问题已在版本1.7.18中修复。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 无需认证即可远程触发，单个节点即可令区块链节点失去响应，严重威胁网络稳定性和可用性。

items.title: Klever-Go is the Go implementation of the Klever blockchain protocol. Versions 1.7.14 through 1.7.17 are vulnerable to a nil-pointer panic triggered by a protobuf Transaction wh...
items.summary: Klever-Go is the Go implementation of the Klever blockchain protocol. Versions 1.7.14 through 1.7.17 are vulnerable to a nil-pointer panic triggered by a protobuf Transaction whose embedded RawData sub-message is omitted. This omission causes RawData to decode to nil. Every transaction gossiped on the Klever-Go P2P network is decoded and validated synchronously inside the libp2p pubsub topic-validator callback, where txVersionChecker.CheckTxVersion dereferences tx.RawData.Version with no nil check. Because the libp2p pubsub callback, the underlying go-libp2p-pubsub validation worker, and Klever's own network/p2p layer install no recover(), the panic propagates and crashes the entire node process. The attacker payload is a 3-byte protobuf message; no validator key, stake, funds, or on-chain account is required, and delivery aimed at enough of the BLS validator set can halt block production, resulting in a chain halt. This issue has been fixed in version 1.7.18.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-52878 是 Klever-Go（Klever 区块链协议的 Go 实现）中的一个拒绝服务漏洞，影响版本 1.7.14 至 1.7.17。漏洞根源在于 protobuf 解码过程中，如果 Transaction 消息的 RawData 子字段缺失，解码后的 RawData 指针为 nil，而随后的交易验证函数 txVersionChecker.CheckTxVersion 直接解引用 tx.RawData.Version，未做空值检查。由于交易在 libp2p pubsub 的 topic-validator 回调中同步处理，调用链上没有 recover() 保护，因此一个恶意构造的极短 protobuf 消息（仅 3 字节）即可触发 nil 指针 panic，导致节点进程崩溃。攻击者无需任何链上资源或凭证，只需通过 P2P 网络传播该恶意交易，若向足够多的 BLS 验证者节点投递，可使整个网络的区块生产停滞，造成链级拒绝服务。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 7.5（高危），攻击复杂度低，可远程利用。修复版本为 1.7.18，强烈建议受影响节点尽快升级。同时，在网络层面限制 P2P 暴露范围可作为临时缓解措施。

items.title: Klever-Go is the Go implementation of the Klever blockchain protocol. In versions prior to 1.7.18, the account-data trie syncers are vulnerable to a resource-exhaustion flaw tha...
items.summary: Klever-Go is the Go implementation of the Klever blockchain protocol. In versions prior to 1.7.18, the account-data trie syncers are vulnerable to a resource-exhaustion flaw that leaks bounded throttler slots on error paths. In syncDataTrie() (in both userAccountsSyncer.go and kappAccountsSyncer.go), StartProcessing() reserves a slot from the NumGoRoutinesThrottler, but the corresponding EndProcessing() is only called on the success path and on the duplicate-root early return. As a result, any error from trie.NewTrie(), trie.NewTrieSyncer(), or trieSyncer.StartSyncing() (including the network-dependent timeout path) permanently consumes one slot for the lifetime of the throttler. An attacker who can repeatedly cause trie-node sync failures or timeouts during bootstrap can exhaust the bounded throttler, after which further account-data trie syncs stop making progress and SyncAccounts() returns a timeout. Because epoch bootstrap in syncUserAccountsState() and syncKappAccountsState() aborts on any such error, this causes bootstrap to fail, a core availability issue affecting fresh, restarting, or resyncing nodes and validators. This issue is fixed in version 1.7.18.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Klever-Go 是 Klever 区块链协议的 Go 实现。在 1.7.18 版本之前，其账户数据 trie 同步器存在一个资源耗尽漏洞，会在错误路径上泄漏有界节流器的槽位。具体而言，在 syncDataTrie() 函数（位于 userAccountsSyncer.go 和 kappAccountsSyncer.go 中）中，StartProcessing() 会从 NumGoRoutinesThrottler 保留一个槽位，但对应的 EndProcessing() 仅在成功路径和“重复根”提前返回时被调用。因此，任何来自 trie.NewTrie()、trie.NewTrieSyncer() 或 trieSyncer.StartSyncing() 的错误（包括依赖网络的超时路径）都会永久消耗一个槽位，直到节流器生命周期结束。攻击者若能在引导期间反复触发 trie 节点同步失败或超时，可以耗尽有界节流器，之后账户数据 trie 的同步将停止推进，SyncAccounts() 会返回超时。由于 epoch 引导在 syncUserAccountsState() 和 syncKappAccountsState() 中遇到任何此类错误都会中止，这会导致引导失败，直接影响新节点、重启节点或重新同步的节点和验证器的核心可用性。修复版本为 1.7.18，修复方式是在错误路径上正确释放槽位。此漏洞属于拒绝服务类问题，攻击者无需认证即可远程触发，但需要一定技巧和条件，CVSS 评分为 5.9（中等）。

items.summary: Ruby LSP is an implementation of the language server protocol for Ruby. Several workspace-level settings in the Ruby LSP VS Code extension prior to version 0.10.4 could override the path to the Ruby executable, the version manager executables, or the Bundler `Gemfile` used at startup. A malicious repository containing a `.vscode/settings.json` could set these values to attacker-controlled targets. Opening and trusting the repository would then execute code with the privileges of the developer. The Ruby LSP gem and clients of the language server in other editors are not affected. Version 0.10.4 of the Ruby LSP VS Code extension fixes the issue.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-48122 影响 Ruby LSP 的 Visual Studio Code 扩展（版本 0.10.4 之前）。Ruby LSP 是 Ruby 语言服务器协议的一种实现，用于提供智能编辑功能。该扩展存在的漏洞是：多个工作区级设置（例如 Ruby 可执行文件路径、版本管理器可执行文件路径、Bundler 使用的 Gemfile 路径）可以被覆盖。若一个恶意仓库包含经过特殊构造的 `.vscode/settings.json` 文件，当开发者打开并信任该仓库时，扩展可能加载攻击者指定的可执行文件或 Gemfile，从而在开发者权限下执行任意代码。此问题仅影响 VS Code 扩展本身；Ruby LSP gem 以及在其他编辑器中使用语言服务器的客户端不受影响。官方已在版本 0.10.4 中修复该漏洞。目前 CVSS 评分和 EPSS 数据未提供，也未标记为已在野外利用或列入 KEV。建议所有使用该扩展的开发者立即升级至 0.10.4 或更高版本，同时谨慎打开来源不明的仓库并审查仓库中的 `.vscode` 配置。

items.summary: Kakoune is a code editor. Prior to version 2026.05.21, the bundled, enabled by default, `autorestore.kak` script can be exploited by malicious backup files leading to arbitrary kakoune and shell commands being executed by simply opening a file. Kakoune 2026.05.21 fixes the issue. As a workaround, add `autorestore-disable` to the user kakrc will disable the autorestore feature.

items.summary: XWiki Platform WebJars API is a package for XWiki, a generic wiki platform. Starting with version 9.6-rc-1 and prior to versions 16.10.17, 17.4.9, and 17.10.3, a potential path traversal vulnerability allow an attacker who manages to get a malicious WebJar extension installed on the wiki to write arbitrary files. While the consequences could be severe like overriding configuration files and setting the superadmin password, the attack first requires that the attacker already has admin access to at least a subwiki to be able to install a malicious extension. Further, the attacker needs to publish a malicious extension in an extension repository that is configured in the instance. This vulnerability has been patched in XWiki 16.10.17, 17.4.9, 17.10.3, and 18.0.0RC1. XWiki is not aware of any workarounds except for being careful whom developers grant script and admin rights to.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-48047 是 XWiki Platform WebJars API 组件中的一个路径遍历漏洞，影响从 9.6-rc-1 到 16.10.17、17.4.9、17.10.3 之前的所有版本。该漏洞允许攻击者在已经成功安装恶意 WebJar 扩展的前提下，向服务器写入任意文件。由于具备任意文件写入能力，攻击者可覆盖配置文件、篡改超级管理员密码，从而可能导致整个 XWiki 实例被完全控制。然而，触发该漏洞的前提条件较为苛刻：攻击者必须首先拥有至少一个子维基的管理员权限，并能将恶意扩展发布到实例所配置的扩展仓库中。XWiki 官方已在 16.10.17、17.4.9、17.10.3 以及 18.0.0RC1 版本中修复该问题。目前官方没有提供除谨慎授权脚本和管理员权限之外的临时缓解措施。建议相关用户尽快升级到已修复版本，并严格限制管理员权限的授予范围，以降低风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可导致任意文件写入，进而覆盖配置和重置管理员密码，对 XWiki 实例构成严重威胁。尽管利用前提需要已有管理员权限并安装恶意扩展，但一旦成功即可完全控制系统，应优先升级修复。

items.summary: lakeFS is an open-source tool that transforms object storage into a Git-like repositories. Prior to version 1.81.1 of the open source edition and 1.84.0 of the enterprise edition, lakeFS Web UI renders markdown files from repository objects without sanitizing the resulting HTML. A user with write access to any repository branch can commit a `.md` object containing arbitrary HTML/JavaScript. Any other user who opens that object, or who navigates to a repository or directory containing a malicious `README.md`, executes the attacker-supplied script in their own authenticated session. lakeFS fixes the issue in v1.81.1 and lakeFS Enterprise fixes the issue in in v1.84.0. Enterprise customers using older versions can temporarily disable Markdown rendering by adding YAML to their config. No workaround exists for OSS release. Users are advised to upgrade to the latest version for both lakeFS and lakeFS-Enterprise.

llm_summary.summary_zh: lakeFS 是一款将对象存储转换为类 Git 仓库的开源工具。其 Web UI 在渲染来自仓库对象的 Markdown 文件时，未对生成的 HTML 进行消毒处理，导致存储型跨站脚本（Stored XSS）漏洞。具体而言，在开源版 1.81.1 之前以及企业版 1.84.0 之前，任何对仓库分支具有写权限的用户，都可以提交包含任意 HTML/JavaScript 的 .md 文件。当其他用户打开该文件，或导航至包含恶意 README.md 的仓库或目录时，攻击者提供的脚本会在受害者已认证的会话中执行，从而可能窃取会话凭证、执行特权操作或篡改数据。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 8.7（高危），攻击向量为网络，攻击复杂度低，需要低权限用户触发，且影响范围为横向。官方已在 lakeFS v1.81.1 和 lakeFS Enterprise v1.84.0 中修复此问题。企业版用户在使用旧版本时，可通过向配置中添加 YAML 临时禁用 Markdown 渲染；开源版则没有临时缓解措施。建议所有用户尽快升级至最新版本，同时注意限制网络暴露面，避免不受信任的用户访问 Web UI。该漏洞目前未被列入 KEV 目录，也无在野利用的明确报告。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许低权限用户提交恶意 Markdown 文件，在他人会话中执行任意脚本，可能导致敏感信息泄露、会话劫持或仓库数据篡改。由于 lakeFS 常用于管理数据基础设施，风险传导严重，且开源版无临时缓解措施，需优先升级。

items.summary: Klever-Go is the Go implementation of the Klever blockchain protocol. Prior to 1.7.18, the P2P resolver request handling logic is vulnerable to hash-array amplification. A connected peer can send a compressed RequestDataType_HashArrayType direct request that is only 442 bytes on the wire but expands into 200,000 decoded hash entries inside the resolver path. The resolver's antiflood logic counts only a single logical message and the compressed wire size, and while Batch.Decompress() caps the decompressed byte size, it never limits the number of decoded repeated-field items. As a result, both TxResolver and TrieNodeResolver preallocate and iterate over the entire unchecked set of decoded hashes, causing remote memory and CPU amplification against any node that accepts P2P peer connections. This issue is fixed in version 1.7.18.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-47249 是 Klever-Go（Klever 区块链协议的 Go 实现）中存在于 1.7.18 之前版本的一个远程拒绝服务漏洞。漏洞根因在于 P2P 解析器（resolver）的请求处理逻辑未能有效限制解码后的哈希条目数量。攻击者只需与节点建立 P2P 连接，即可发送一个经过压缩的 RequestDataType_HashArrayType 直接请求，该请求在网络上仅占 442 字节，但经过 Batch.Decompress() 解压后，会在解析器路径中扩展为 200,000 个解码后的哈希条目。解析器的防洪水（antiflood）逻辑仅按单条逻辑消息和压缩后的线级大小计数，而 Batch.Decompress() 虽然限制了解压后的字节大小，却从未限制解码后的重复字段项数量。因此，TxResolver 和 TrieNodeResolver 在处理时会预先分配并遍历这一整套未经检查的解码哈希集合，导致任何接受 P2P 对等连接的节点遭受远程内存和 CPU 放大攻击。该漏洞影响所有使用 Klever-Go 且版本低于 1.7.18 的节点。CVSS 评分为 7.5（高），攻击向量为网络，攻击复杂度低，无需 privileges 或用户交互，仅影响可用性（A:H）。修复版本为 1.7.18，建议所有受影响的节点尽快升级。在无法立即升级的情况下，应限制 P2P 端口的网络暴露，仅允许可信节点连接，并加强网络层访问控制以降低被利用风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 未修复的 Klever-Go 节点可被远程攻击者以极小的流量触发大规模内存和 CPU 消耗，导致节点不可用。由于攻击条件简单（仅需 P2P 连接），且 CVSS 7.5 高评分，应优先升级至 1.7.18 并收紧 P2P 暴露面。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 远程未认证攻击者可通过发送特制的压缩哈希数组请求，触发 200,000 个哈希条目的解码与处理，造成节点内存和 CPU 资源被大量占用，导致拒绝服务。

items.summary: Ghostfolio is an open source wealth management software. Prior to version 3.4.0, Ghostfolio's Stripe checkout success-URL handler at `GET /api/v1/subscription/stripe/callback?checkoutSessionId=<id>` retrieves the Stripe Checkout Session by ID and unconditionally grants a Premium subscription to the session's `client_reference_id` — without ever checking `session.payment_status` or `session.status`. There is no separate Stripe webhook endpoint with `stripe-signature` verification; this callback is the sole code path that creates Stripe-driven subscriptions. Any authenticated user can self-grant a 1-year Premium subscription without ever paying. Version 3.4.0 rejects sessions unless `session.payment_status === 'paid'` AND `session.status === 'complete'` (fails closed). Additionally, new unique `stripeCheckoutSessionId` column → a session can't be redeemed twice (race-safe via DB unique constraint).

llm_summary.summary_zh: Ghostfolio 是一款开源财富管理软件。在 3.4.0 版本之前，其 Stripe 结账成功回调接口 `GET /api/v1/subscription/stripe/callback?checkoutSessionId=<id>` 存在严重的支付校验缺失漏洞。该接口仅凭客户端提供的 checkoutSessionId 从 Stripe 检索 Checkout Session，然后无条件地为该会话的 `client_reference_id` 所对应的用户授予 Premium 订阅权限，完全不检查 `session.payment_status`（是否已付款）和 `session.status`（是否完成）。同时，该应用没有独立的 Stripe webhook 端点进行 `stripe-signature` 签名验证，这个回调是唯一处理 Stripe 驱动的订阅创建路径。因此，任何已认证的普通用户都可以构造请求，调用此回调并传入一个自定义的 Checkout Session ID，从而在不支付任何费用的情况下为自己激活长达一年的 Premium 订阅。这属于认证后的逻辑漏洞，CVSS 评分为 6.5（中危），攻击复杂度低，无需用户交互，对完整性影响高（C:N/I:H/A:N）。修复版本 3.4.0 严格校验 `session.payment_status === 'paid'` 且 `session.status === 'complete'`，以失败关闭的方式拒绝未支付或未完成的会话；同时新增唯一的 `stripeCheckoutSessionId` 数据库列，通过唯一约束确保同一个 Checkout Session 不能被重复兑换，从而防止并发或重放攻击。该漏洞的实际业务影响是攻击者可免费获取付费功能，造成收入损失，但需要已认证的用户身份，未发现已公开的利用事件。建议所有使用 Ghostfolio 的实例尽快升级到 3.4.0 或更高版本，并审查应用日志中是否存在异常的订阅创建记录。

items.summary: OpenYak is a local-first agent runtime for reliable tool-using models, with a desktop workspace built on top. Prior to version 1.1.3, the OpenYak desktop backend binds an HTTP API to `127.0.0.1:<random port>` (commonly 19141) without server-side Origin validation, loopback authentication, or Content-Type enforcement, and with a wildcard CORS policy. Any webpage a user visits while OpenYak is running can issue cross-origin requests to this local server — the browser acts as a proxy into loopback, bypassing OS-level network isolation. Chained, this lets a malicious page execute arbitrary shell commands on the host (RCE) via the build agent with `permission_presets.bash=true`, shut down the service, and exfiltrate chat history and account PII — with no user interaction beyond opening the page. Version 1.1.3 patches the issue.

llm_summary.summary_zh: OpenYak 是一款本地优先的智能体运行时，专门用于可靠地调用工具的模型，并在此基础上提供桌面工作区。在 1.1.3 版本之前，OpenYak 的桌面后端存在一个严重安全缺陷：其 HTTP API 被绑定在 127.0.0.1 的随机端口（通常为 19141）上，但服务端既没有校验请求的 Origin 来源，也没有实施回环认证或 Content-Type 强制策略，同时还配置了通配符 CORS。这意味着，当用户在使用 OpenYak 的同时浏览任意网页时，该网页中的恶意脚本可以向本地 API 发起跨源请求。由于浏览器成为访问回环地址的中介，攻击者可以绕过操作系统对网络访问的隔离限制。更严重的是，攻击者可结合构建代理（当 permission_presets.bash 设置为 true 时）在宿主设备上执行任意操作系统命令，实现远程代码执行；还可以关闭服务或窃取聊天记录及账户个人身份信息。整个攻击过程无需用户执行任何交互，只需用户正常打开一个网页。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 9.6，属于严重级别，攻击复杂度低且可造成高机密性、完整性和可用性影响。OpenYak 1.1.3 版本已修复此问题，建议所有用户尽快升级。

items.summary: Kata Containers is an open source implementation of lightweight Virtual Machines (VMs) that perform like containers. In versions prior to 4.0.0, the kata-agent is vulnerable to an authorization bypass in confidential-guest memory management. In Confidential Containers (CoCo) deployments, the kata-agent enforces an OPA/Rego-based AgentPolicy that must authorize every ttRPC API call, forming the security boundary that prevents an untrusted host from directing the confidential guest. Two ttRPC methods introduced with the mem-agent feature are missing this authorization check, so an untrusted host can invoke them unconditionally regardless of the guest's policy configuration. When mem-agent is enabled (off by default), this lets the host tamper with in-guest memory management by forcing swap, aggressive eviction, or compaction, resulting in attacker-controlled availability and performance degradation of the confidential workload entirely outside the agent-policy boundary. The impact does not include memory disclosure or code execution, and severity is bounded by the precondition that mem-agent must be explicitly enabled. This issue is fixed in version 4.0.0.

items.summary: Klever-Go is the Go implementation of the Klever blockchain protocol. Prior to 1.7.20, header signature verification counts the unused padding bits of the PubKeysBitmap toward the two-thirds validator quorum. These padding bits do not correspond to any validator and are ignored by the actual BLS aggregate-signature check, so a malicious or compromised block producer can set them to reach the required quorum while gathering fewer genuine validator signatures than the protocol demands. As a result, nodes that import or intercept the header accept it as correctly signed without a real two-thirds quorum, weakening consensus safety and undermining finality. This issue is fixed in version 1.7.20.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-58262 是 Klever-Go（Klever 区块链协议的 Go 实现）中存在于 1.7.20 之前版本的一个共识安全漏洞。漏洞根因在于区块头签名验证逻辑错误地将 PubKeysBitmap 中未使用的填充位计入了验证者投票权重，使其被纳入三分之二验证者法定人数的计算。然而，在后续的 BLS 聚合签名检查中，这些填充位因为不对应任何真实验证者而被忽略。攻击者（恶意或受损的区块生产者）可以利用该不一致性，通过设置这些填充位来人为凑足法定的三分之二多数，而实际收集到的合法验证者签名数量远低于协议要求。这导致网络中的节点在导入或拦截区块头时，会误将其视为已获得足够共识的合法签名，从而接受一个实际上并未获得真正三分之二验证者背书的区块头。该漏洞直接削弱了区块链的共识安全性和最终性保证，可能被用于制造区块分歧或破坏链上数据的可信性。修复方式是将 Klever-Go 升级至 1.7.20 或更高版本，该版本已修正签名验证逻辑，确保只统计真实验证者的签名并正确执行法定人数检查。建议所有运行受影响版本的节点尽快升级，同时检查当前部署版本是否处于漏洞影响范围，并限制节点网络暴露以减少被利用的风险。

items.title: `scim-patch`, a library to perform SCIM patch, prior to version 0.9.1 performs prototype pollution when applying a SCIM PATCH operation whose `value` object contains a key like ...
items.summary:
`scim-patch`, a library to perform SCIM patch, prior to version 0.9.1 performs prototype pollution when applying a SCIM PATCH operation whose `value` object contains a key like `"__proto__.someProp"`. After one such patch,
`Object.prototype.someProp` is set process-wide, affecting every plain object in the Node process. Any service that calls `scimPatch()` on attacker-controlled JSON (i.e. any SCIM endpoint accepting `PATCH` from an external IdP) is exploitable on a stock Node runtime. Version 0.9.1 contains a patch. A workaround is available. Calling `Object.freeze(Object.prototype)` (and the same on `Array.prototype`, `Function.prototype`) at process startup neutralizes this class of bug — assignment to a frozen prototype becomes a silent no-op in sloppy mode or a `TypeError` in strict mode. Node's `--frozen-intrinsics` flag does this for built-ins automatically.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-48170 影响 scim-patch 库（用于执行 SCIM PATCH 操作的 Node.js 库），其 0.9.1 之前的版本在应用包含形如 "__proto__.someProp" 键的 value 对象时，会触发原型污染（prototype pollution）。攻击者可通过向 SCIM 端点提交特制的 PATCH 请求（例如来自外部 IdP 的 JSON），使库在处理时向 Object.prototype 写入 someProp 属性，从而影响 Node 进程中所有普通对象。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 9.1（高危），攻击向量为网络，攻击复杂度低，需要低权限，影响范围可波及整个系统，对完整性有高影响，对可用性有低影响。官方已在 0.9.1 版本中修复该问题。缓解方案包括：升级到 0.9.1 或更高版本；若无法升级，可在进程启动时调用 Object.freeze(Object.prototype)（以及 Array.prototype、Function.prototype），使原型污染赋值变成静默无效（非严格模式）或抛出 TypeError（严格模式）；也可使用 Node 的 --frozen-intrinsics 标志自动冻结内置原型。建议所有使用该库处理外部输入的 SCIM 服务尽快升级，并限制 PATCH 端点的网络暴露范围，仅允许可信 IdP 访问。当前无证据表明该漏洞已被在野利用或已列入 KEV。

items.summary: PraisonAI is a multi-agent teams system. Versions prior to 0.1.4 of the PraisonAI Platform API have two authorization failures that together break workspace isolation. The service layer for issues and projects performs global primary-key lookups without checking workspace ownership, so any authenticated user can read, modify, and delete resources in any workspace just by swapping UUIDs in their API requests. On top of that, every member management endpoint (add, update role, remove) only requires `min_role="member"`, which lets any workspace member promote themselves to owner and kick out the original owner. A low-privilege member of one workspace can steal data from every other workspace and take over any workspace they belong to. Both issues come from the same gap: the route layer pulls `workspace_id` from the URL and verifies membership, but the service layer ignores the workspace scope for resource lookups and ignores the caller's role level for member operations. The `require_workspace_member()` dependency does its job correctly. The problem is that the service layer doesn't use the information it provides. Version 0.1.4 of the PraisonAI Platform API patch the issue.

llm_summary.summary_zh: PraisonAI 是一个多智能体团队系统，其 Platform API 在 0.1.4 版本之前存在两个授权缺陷，二者叠加会彻底破坏工作区隔离。第一个缺陷位于 issues 和 projects 的服务层：该层执行全局主键查询时未校验工作区所有权，任何已认证用户只需在 API 请求中替换目标资源的 UUID，即可读取、修改或删除任意工作区中的资源。第二个缺陷涉及成员管理端点（添加成员、更新角色、移除成员），这些端点仅要求调用者具备 min_role="member"，意味着任何工作区成员都能将自己提升为所有者，并可以踢出原所有者。因此，一个低权限成员不仅能窃取所有其他工作区的数据，还能完全接管其所属的任意工作区。两个问题的根源相同：路由层从 URL 中提取 workspace_id 并验证成员资格，但服务层在进行资源查询时忽略了工作区作用域，在成员操作时也忽略了调用者的角色级别。require_workspace_member() 依赖本身工作正常，问题在于服务层没有使用其提供的信息。版本 0.1.4 已修复该问题。此漏洞风险高，攻击者只需普通用户权限即可利用，建议立即升级到 0.1.4 或更高版本，同时限制 API 的网络暴露范围，并审查现有工作区中的成员角色配置，确保没有异常提权操作。

items.summary: Kata Containers is an open source project focusing on a standard implementation of lightweight Virtual Machines (VMs) that perform like containers. Prior to 3.31.0, the runtime-rs standalone virtio-fs path is vulnerable to a guest-root to host-root escape. In this configuration, Kata runs the host virtiofsd as root with --sandbox none --seccomp none, so an attacker with root-equivalent access inside the guest can bypass the guest virtio-fs client entirely by taking over the virtio-fs PCI device and building a virtqueue in userspace to submit raw FUSE requests directly to the host virtiofsd. A crafted FUSE_SYMLINK request whose new symlink name is an absolute host path is honored outside the configured shared directory, allowing guest root to create root-owned symlinks in sensitive host locations such as /etc/cron.d. By pointing such a symlink at a guest-controlled crontab payload reachable through a live runtime process's mount namespace, the attacker causes the host cron daemon to execute that payload as host root, crossing the Kata isolation boundary. This issue is fixed in version 3.31.0.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-47243 是 Kata Containers 项目中一个影响 runtime-rs standalone virtio-fs 路径的严重漏洞，源于该配置下宿主机的 virtiofsd 进程以 root 权限运行，并且使用了 --sandbox none --seccomp none 参数，从而完全关闭了沙箱和 seccomp 保护。攻击者若已在虚拟机内获得 root 等价权限，可以绕过 guest 内的 virtio-fs 客户端，直接接管 virtio-fs PCI 设备，在用户态构造 virtqueue，向宿主机 virtiofsd 提交原始 FUSE 请求。具体而言，攻击者可以构造特殊的 FUSE_SYMLINK 请求，其新符号链接名设置为宿主机上的绝对路径，导致该请求在配置的共享目录之外被处理，从而允许 guest root 在宿主机敏感位置（如 /etc/cron.d）创建指向 guest 控制内容的符号链接。通过将符号链接指向运行时进程挂载命名空间中可访问的 crontab payload，攻击者可诱导宿主机 cron 守护进程以宿主机 root 身份执行该 payload，彻底打破 Kata 的隔离边界。该漏洞已在 Kata Containers 3.31.0 版本中修复。由于攻击前提是 guest 内已有 root 权限，通常意味着攻击者已攻破一个容器或 VM，但此漏洞使攻击者能够逃逸到宿主机，属于隔离机制完全失效的风险。建议所有使用受影响配置的用户立即升级到 3.31.0 或更高版本，并在升级前限制暴露面，避免不受信任的工作负载运行在相关配置上。

items.title: OpenBao is an open source identity-based secrets management system. Prior to version 2.5.4, in OpenBao's Kerberos auth method on the `GET` handler, or when an `Authorization: Ne...
items.summary: OpenBao is an open source identity-based secrets management system. Prior to version 2.5.4, in OpenBao's Kerberos auth method on the `GET` handler, or when an `Authorization: Negotiate` header is supplied, the response is includes a `logical.Auth` object in addition to an error message. This results in tokens being created with only the default policy, default TTL, and no entity information, which are hidden by the returned error message. No access to these tokens by the caller occurs and the authentication token is not ever made accessible outside of `sys/raw`. This is fixed in OpenBao v2.5.4. As a workaround, users may set a rate limit quota to limit the creation of these paths. As the path is unauthenticated, it isn't possible to deny access to it.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-46405 是 OpenBao（开源身份基础密钥管理系统）中的一个漏洞，影响 2.5.4 之前的所有版本。在 Kerberos 认证方法的 GET 处理器中，或当请求带有 Authorization: Negotiate 头时，响应中除了错误信息外还会包含一个 logical.Auth 对象。这导致系统会创建仅具有默认策略、默认 TTL 且无实体信息的令牌，而这些令牌被返回的错误信息所掩盖。由于调用方无法访问这些令牌，认证令牌也不会在 sys/raw 之外被暴露，因此实际利用难度较高，但未经身份验证的攻击者可以通过构造特定请求触发令牌创建，从而消耗系统资源。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 5.3（中危），攻击向量为网络，无需特权，但影响仅为可用性（低）。OpenBao v2.5.4 已修复此问题。缓解措施包括设置速率限制配额，以限制这些路径的创建频率，但由于路径本身无需认证，无法直接拒绝访问。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: OpenBao 作为身份密钥管理系统，此漏洞允许未认证用户引发不必要的令牌创建，虽不直接泄露敏感数据，但可能造成资源消耗，影响系统可用性。建议尽快升级至 v2.5.4 或设置速率限制。
